digestFixup: WHEN + WHO (v2): run exactly once, after this publish-once branch merges to main AND the publish-images.yml CI run on that main HEAD (call it H) is green — CI then has pushed ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-twenty:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-branding, ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-twenty:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-venue and ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-pos-gateway:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-pos-gateway, where <H12> is the first 12 hex of H. Executor: release owner/integrator with GHCR read access. No image is published from any branch, and the retired v1 tags sha-abd67ec1f0b2-branding, sha-abd67ec1f0b2-venue, sha-abd67ec1f0b2-pos-gateway (and the older sha-08dd2de9e097-* set) are NEVER republished, overwritten or reused for new content (R13 + R02: tags are publish-once; an existing tag is reused by digest, never rebuilt).

RENAME (new in v2 — a commit cannot contain its own hash, so the dep12 committed here, 29e243801137, can never equal the publish HEAD H): recompute the three tag names as sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-branding, sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-venue, sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-pos-gateway with <H12> = first 12 hex of the green CI publish HEAD H. Put them into release/mahabbat-release.json images.branding/venue/posGateway.immutableTag AND image-digests.lock.json images.branding/venue/posGateway.immutableTag (lock and manifest blessed tags must agree exactly); set image-digests.lock.json tagScheme.dep12/deploymentSha to <H12>/H.

RESOLVE (mirror of the CI record-digests step) — for each renamed ref run: docker buildx imagetools inspect <ref> --format '{{json .Manifest}}' and copy the "digest":"sha256:<64hex>" value. Refs: ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-twenty:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-branding ; ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-twenty:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-venue ; ghcr.io/michaelyosta/mahabbat-pos-gateway:sha-46c853be3f65-<H12>-pos-gateway. If a tag is missing, the CI publish on H was not green — do NOT invent digests, do NOT fall back to any retired tag.

WRITE: put the three digests into release/mahabbat-release.json images.branding.digest, images.venue.digest, images.posGateway.digest respectively; set deploymentSha to the full publish HEAD H (its first 12 hex MUST equal the dep12 inside the three tag names); upstream-twenty.lock.json is NOT part of this fixup (upstream lock is frozen).

COMMIT (same shape as 05cdd57 'release 1.1.0-rc.1: published digests + deployment SHA' but manifest+lock): commit ONLY release/mahabbat-release.json and image-digests.lock.json — this commit does NOT retrigger publish-images.yml (the manifest and schema are intentionally not publish triggers; a fixup must never mint an orphan tag set), then run node --test deploy/__tests__/release-coherence.regression.test.mjs — must be fully green before handing to T7/T8. If the merge to main rewrote history (non-fast-forward), H is the new main HEAD: recompute <H12> from it in the RENAME step above.
